(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (pt< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (normalize pts)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells pts))
             (r0 (first bb))
             (c0 (second bb)))
        (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) pts) pt<)))
    (define (rot1 pts)
      (let ((maxr (apply max (map first pts))))
        (normalize (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p)))) pts))))
    (define (rotate pts k)
      (let loop ([n (modulo k 4)] [acc pts])
        (if (= n 0) acc (loop (- n 1) (rot1 acc)))))
    (define (code-rot v)
      (cond [(= v 2) 0] [(= v 4) 1] [(= v 6) 2] [(= v 9) 3] [else #f]))
    (define base (normalize (find-color g 3)))
    (fold-cells g (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
      (lambda (out r c v)
        (if (and (= v 1) (> c 0))
            (let ((rot (code-rot (at g r (- c 1)))))
              (if (eq? rot #f)
                  out
                  (for/fold ([acc out]) ([p (in-list (rotate base rot))])
                    (let ((rr (+ r (first p))) (cc (+ c (second p))))
                      (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))
                          (set-cell acc rr cc 8)
                          acc)))))
            out)))))
